newsitem.title: USA: Gantos August same store sales down.
newsitem.headline: Gantos August same store sales down.

text.p: Gantos Inc said Thursday that same store sales for the four weeks ended August 31 decreased by five percent.
Net sales for the four week period were $11.1 million, down five percent from a year ago.
Gantos said net sales for the 30 weeks ended August 31 were $103.4 million, down three percent from a year ago. Same store sales for that period also declined three percent.
Gantos said the shift in its retail calendar had no impact on comparable store sales.
